The '''Nyriaan Concord''' was the [[Planet/Legends|planetary]] government of the world [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]].

==History==
The Nyriaan Concord was created by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in [[30 BBY/Legends|30 BBY]] under the terms of the [[Luire Accord]], in an attempt by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] to resolve tensions between the native [[Nyriaanan]]s and the various [[Mining/Legends|mining]] corporations that operated on the planet. The Concord was based in [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of Nyriaan, and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Amar Cros]] became the leader of the Concord's native delegation. However, Cros found the political body to be corrupt and ill-prepared, and he left in disgust.
